title: Consolidate and remove v1 config surface and routing shim
creator: Asha Patel
description: Summary: Remove the compatibility surface for the v1 configuration and routing shim that was kept for legacy clients. This ticket consolidates remaining v1 config mappings, deprecates the /api/v1/route/* endpoints used only by the rollout shim, drops the feature flags that gate v1 behavior, and removes DB artifacts and migration helpers.
comments: 2026-02-11 — Planning: Spent time auditing code paths that still read v1_config and legacy_routing_map. Found three services that still reference the shim: routing-service, rollout-controller, and console-legacy-proxy.

2026-02-17 — Design review: Agreed on a compatibility window of 4 weeks. Strategy: (1) introduce runtime warnings in logs when v1 configs are detected; (2) automatically migrate simple v1->v2 mappings for supported keys; (3) keep a read-only migration table for 8 weeks before drop.

2026-02-23 — Engineering kickoff: Marcus created feature branch eng/11012-remove-v1-surface. Primary tasks: code removal, migration job, integration tests, e2e smoke for console routes, docs update, rollout plan.
2026-02-28 — PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3472 — initial code removal and migration job scaffold. Added a CLI flag --force-migrate for internal testing.

2026-03-03 — QA: Found one failing scenario where a tenant had a custom rollout variant keyed only on v1 flags. Added a migration mapping and an automated sanity-check that verifies equivalent behavior post-migration.
2026-03-05 — Observability: Added dashboard panels to console:Routing -> 'v1 config detections' and 'migrated mappings per tenant'. Alert set: if >0 detections after 2026-03-24, page SRE oncall.

2026-03-08 — Staging rollout: Deployed migration job to staging and ran against snapshot of production configs. No data loss; two tenants required manual review due to custom scripts in their rollout configs. PM reached out to customers for guidance.
2026-03-10 — In Progress: Preparing gradual prod rollout plan (canary by account tier). Next step: schedule canary for 2026-03-15 and full rollout 2026-03-22 if no regressions.
